strategy.offer: Standard and custom glass, quartz, carrier and compound wafers, including structured, coated, polished and cleanroom-packaged substrates for semiconductor and microsystems manufacturing.
strategy.customers: Semiconductor, MEMS, optoelectronics and microfluidics manufacturers needing precision substrates, packaging wafers and thin-wafer handling for industrial, consumer, automotive and scientific applications.
strategy.why_we_win: It argues precise tolerances, high-quality surfaces, material matching, flexible customization, and process integration improve yield, reliability and manufacturability in demanding wafer-level processes.
strategy.resources: Basis includes advanced polishing, etching, drilling and measurement technologies, broad materials know-how, cleanroom packaging, direct technical support, and trained production specialists.
strategy.direction: Expanding thinner and larger-format substrates, reusable carriers and multifunctional packaging wafers for increasingly complex semiconductor and microsystems applications.

context.industry: Manufacture of other non-metallic mineral products

strategy.offer: Customized precision wafers, packaging and carrier solutions, interconnect substrates, microfluidic components, and related processing, prototyping, and manufacturing services.
strategy.customers: Industrial customers in electronics, automotive, aerospace, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, medical, and sensor markets, from development projects to direct mass-production supply.
strategy.why_we_win: It combines application-specific design, very high surface precision, tight tolerances, functional integration, and customer collaboration with manufacturing suited for volume production.
strategy.resources: In-house polishing and patterning know-how, long glass and quartz processing experience, certified quality systems, group manufacturing capabilities, and direct plus online sales channels.
strategy.direction: Expand higher-value applications and proprietary products, invest in newer processing technologies and capacity, grow complete systems, and shift simpler standard production to lower-cost manufacturing.
